"""End-to-end: random batch -> submission/main.py -> compare with the reference."""
import ctypes, json, random, subprocess, sys
ctypes.CDLL('/workspace/vendor/system-libs/libz.so.1', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
import ref, gen, gen2, gen3

seed = int(sys.argv[1]); count = int(sys.argv[2])
rng = random.Random(seed)
jobs = []
for i in range(count):
    pick = i % 3
    jobs.append(gen.make_job(rng, i) if pick == 0 else (gen2.make_job(rng, i) if pick == 1 else gen3.make_job(rng, i)))
payload = json.dumps({'jobs': jobs}).encode()
proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '/workspace/submission/main.py'],
                      input=payload, capture_output=True)
if proc.returncode:
    print('FAILED rc', proc.returncode, proc.stderr.decode()[-2000:]); sys.exit(1)
got = json.loads(proc.stdout)
assert set(got) == {'results'}, got.keys()
expect = {'results': [ref.compile_job(json.loads(json.dumps(job))) for job in jobs]}
ok = got == expect
print('jobs', count, 'match', ok)
if not ok:
    for i, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(got['results'], expect['results'])):
        if a != b:
            print('job', i, json.dumps(jobs[i]))
            for k in ('rules', 'active', 'answers'):
                if a[k] != b[k]:
                    print(' ', k, 'got', json.dumps(a[k])[:800])
                    print(' ', k, 'exp', json.dumps(b[k])[:800])
            break
    sys.exit(1)
# also verify strict json (no duplicate keys / nonfinite) like the checker does
def pairs(items):
    out = {}
    for k, v in items:
        if k in out: raise ValueError('duplicate key')
        out[k] = v
    return out
def bad(v): raise ValueError('nonfinite')
json.loads(proc.stdout.decode('utf-8'), object_pairs_hook=pairs, parse_constant=bad)
print('strict json ok; stdout bytes', len(proc.stdout))
PYEOF
